name: Ultralight Walnut Accent, Black Felt
summary: Real walnut veneer laminated onto 9mm recycled black acoustic felt, with a continuous face and no rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: two 300 mm panels, each with a continuous 297 mm veneer face and no internal slats, meeting at a 3 mm wide, 1.5 mm deep 90-degree V reveal; total thickness is 9 mm. Pale taupe-brown walnut color is sampled from main.jpg with black felt at joins; grain wraps over 750 mm vertically, and Accent is not suitable for wrapping columns per the spec sheet.
